mapper.select: SELECT c.CART_ID, p.STORE_ID, p.STORE_NAME, p.PRO_NO, p.PRO_NAME, c.LETTERING_WORD, P.PRICE AS DEF_PRICE, c.CART_QUANTITY, c.TOTAL_PRICE, po.TOP_OPTION_ID, po.OPTION_NAME AS TOP_OPT, pso.SUB_OPTION_ID, pso.VALUE_NAME AS SUB_OPT, co.CART_OPT_QUANTITY, NVL(pso.PRICE_DIFF, 0) AS SUB_OPT_PRICE, c.CHAT_YN, c.DELIVERY_FEE, c.DELIVERY_TYPE, c.CREATED_AT, c.CHAT_YN, USER_ADDR, PHONE, USER_NAME, STORE_ADDR, pi.FILEPATH, pi.FILENAME FROM CART_TBL c JOIN PRODUCT_TBL p ON c.PRO_NO = p.PRO_NO JOIN CART_OPTION_TBL co ON c.CART_ID = co.CART_ID JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL pso ON co.SUB_OPTION_ID = pso.SUB_OPTION_ID JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL po ON pso.TOP_OPTION_ID = po.TOP_OPTION_ID JOIN USER_TBL U ON U.USER_ID = C.USER_ID JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON C.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG_TBL pi ON p.PRO_NO = pi.PRO_NO AND pi.FILEUSE = 'T' WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT

mapper.select: SELECT W.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, W.PRO_NO, W.WISH_AT, P.PRO_NAME, P.PRO_TYPE, P.STORE_NAME, P.PRICE, P.DELIVERY_FEE, P.PRO_INFO, P.LETTERING, S.IS_CHAT_ENABLED, I.FILEPATH, I.FILENAME FROM WISHLIST_TBL W INNER JOIN PRODUCT_TBL P ON W.PRO_NO = P.PRO_NO INNER JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON P.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID INNER JOIN USER_TBL U ON W.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG_TBL I ON P.PRO_NO = I.PRO_NO AND I.FILEUSE = 'T' WHERE W.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY W.WISH_AT DESC

SELECT Q.QUESTION_ID, Q.PRO_NO, Q.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME AS userName, Q.QUESTION_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(Q.QUESTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS QUESTION_DATE, Q.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, Q.ANSWER_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(Q.ANSWER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ANSWER_DATE FROM QA_TBL Q LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON Q.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON Q.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT_TBL T ON Q.PRO_NO = T.PRO_NO WHERE T.PRO_NO = #{proNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN Q.ANSWER_CONTENT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, Q.QUESTION_DATE DESC OFFSET #{page} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
